species: We deleted the tRNA-Leu(CAG) gene of Saccharomycopsis capsularis and found that it is not essential.
cell_type: In the yeast genera Saccharomycopsis and Ascoidea, which comprise the taxonomic order Ascoideales, nuclear genes use a nonstandard genetic code
disease_state: Transformants were viable and there were no obvious morphological differences (of colonies or of cells examined by light microscopy) between the deletion strains and the wild-type strain
sample_source: We therefore conducted proteome analysis by tandem mass spectrometry of cultures of two species, S. capsularis and S. fermentans, grown in sporulation conditions.
strain: To test whether the tRNA-Leu(CAG) gene is essential in a Saccharomycopsis species, we deleted it by a CRISPR-Cas9 approach in S. capsularis strain NRRL Y-17639.
